title: Gabbing With Ga......You know
episode_summary: A three-hour FFS Cast panel stream centred initially on its continuing conflict with Frog Tony, Rev Ruin, Stray Beans and adjacent creators. The hosts revisit the origin of the feud, disputed strike/doxxing and 'gay-op' allegations, old interactions involving Liam Gray, and their belief that opponents are retreating from drama before launching comic projects. The stream later broadens into clips, internet commentary and panel banter. Much of the material is adversarial recollection rather than independently verified fact.
